summary: Master the art of Business Cycle Analysis and Economic Forecasting. Join our expert-led training course to elevate your analytical capabilities today.
lede: Business cycle analysis and economic forecasting help finance and planning professionals interpret economic signals and prepare defensible plans. Participants learn to identify cycle phases, track indicators such as inflation, interest rates, and exchange rates, build forecasts with stated assumptions and ranges, and stress-test scenarios. They also practice translating forecast results into budgeting, procurement, pricing, and other operational decisions while explaining uncertainty clearly.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly need to interpret economic conditions and forecast outcomes.
audience: Central bank, treasury, and public sector analysts
modules: Business Cycles Without the Academic Fog
Inflation, Interest Rates, and Central Bank Signals
Building Practical Forecasts for Planning and Budgeting
Forecasting Pitfalls, Bias, and Bad Incentives
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of economic principles and experience in decision-making roles that require budgeting or forecasting.
